name: Natters
kurzbeschreibung: Charming village on the Sonnenplateau, featuring the Natterer Weiher lake and a stunning view of the Innsbrucker Nordkette.
beschreibung:
Natters lies at an altitude of 783 meters on a sun-drenched plateau south of the Nordkette, only about ten minutes from Innsbruck. With around 2,100 residents, the municipality belongs to the district of Innsbruck-Land and offers a rare blend of rural calm and urban proximity.

The heart of the village is the Natterer Weiher 🌲, an artificially created swimming lake that attracts families, swimmers, and walkers in summer. A shallow bathing area, sunbathing lawns, and a children's playground make it a popular excursion destination – not only for locals, but also for guests from the Inntal. Several hiking trails start directly from the village, for example up to the Natterer Alm or along the Panoramaweg with views of the rugged limestone walls of the Nordkette, which appears close enough to touch. Mountain bikers appreciate the tour toward Aldrans, and in winter smaller ski touring routes are within reach.

Culinarily, inns such as Gasthof Natters focus on Tiroler cuisine with regional ingredients – Kasnocken, Gröstl, and homemade Strudel are on the menu. Village life revolves around the Pfarrkirche hl. Margaretha and the regular village festival. Anyone seeking Innsbruck's culture and bustle but wanting to stay in quiet in the evening will find in Natters an ideal starting point – honest, down-to-earth, and without tourist overload.
